title: Sub-networks
description: Splits devices into separate networks. Devices in the same network can communicate. To let two different networks communicate, you connect them explicitly.
noDevices: No devices yet. Add one to use this network.
isolated: Isolated: does not communicate with other networks.

picker.search: Search by name, country or network address

addDialog.description: The devices you pick leave the network they are in now.

connectDialog.description: The two connected networks can communicate in both directions. Access rules still apply: the link does not replace them.
connectDialog.none: It is already connected to every other network.

deleteDialog.title: Delete {{name}}?
deleteDialog.description: Its devices go back to the default network and its links are removed.
